svg.title: MAXWELL NIXON — systems, worlds and ideas
svg.desc: Three luminous gateways: a circuit, a wireframe world and a constellation. Segmented rims rotate, depth rings travel outward, and energy flows across a reflective grid.

g.text: systems · operating systems · games · web · local AI
> three game engines, one process, one portal
> a Linux distro that builds and boots from one command
> a whole game launcher in 90 KB
> local AI on one GPU, nothing leaves the house
> IT for law firms and courtrooms, 9 to 5
